title: Loss of Use, Towing and Rental Benefits under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
Alongside the repair of the vehicle itself, the Keyturn Host Protection Plan publishes for each plan a daily sum for loss of use and the longest period it runs for, a ceiling on towing and storage, and a daily sum for rental reimbursement.

| Plan | Loss of use, USD per day | Loss of use, longest period in days | Towing and storage limit, USD | Rental reimbursement, USD per day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 0 | 0 | 500 | 0 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 35 | 7 | 750 | 0 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 50 | 10 | 1000 | 40 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 65 | 14 | 1500 | 55 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 85 | 21 | 2500 | 75 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 120 | 30 | 4000 | 110 |

### Where a benefit is not carried

A plan whose published daily sum is 0 carries no benefit of that kind. The Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan publishes 0 for loss of use and 0 days for it; the Keyturn Shield 90 and Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plans both publish 0 for rental reimbursement. Towing and storage is carried on every plan in the ladder, from 500 on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan to 4000 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan.

### Boundary illustration (hypothetical figures)

Take a hypothetical vehicle written on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan. Its published daily sum for loss of use is 50 and its longest period is 10 days, so no more than 500 of loss of use can ever be published under that plan for one loss; the same vehicle written on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan would publish 120 a day over as many as 30 days.
